WITH locally_funded AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`School Name` AS SchoolName,
        s.DOCType,
        (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Local'
),
avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM locally_funded
)
SELECT
    lf.SchoolName,
    lf.DOCType
FROM locally_funded lf
CROSS JOIN avg_diff ad
WHERE lf.diff > ad.avg_diff;

WITH latest_frpm AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Academic Year` = (SELECT MAX(`Academic Year`) FROM frpm)
),
top_school AS (
    SELECT f.CDSCode, f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment
    FROM latest_frpm f
    WHERE f.`Low Grade` = '1' 
      AND f.`High Grade` = '12'
    ORDER BY enrollment DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM top_school t
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = t.CDSCode;

SELECT s.City, SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS TotalEnrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY TotalEnrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    `School Name`,
    `Enrollment (K-12)`,
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)`,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC) AS rn
  FROM frpm
  WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  `School Name`,
  `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / NULLIF(`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) AS eligible_free_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN (10, 11)
ORDER BY rn;

WITH top_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f.`School Name`,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS frpm_cnt,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enroll
    FROM frpm f
    WHERE f.IRC = 66
      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
    ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
    `School Name`,
    ROUND(frpm_cnt * 1.0 / enroll, 4) AS eligible_free_reduced_rate
FROM top_schools;

SELECT s.Website, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT 
    frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / NULLIF(frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, 0) AS free_rate
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' 
  AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT TRIM(AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1) AS full_name
FROM schools, top_school
WHERE schools.CDSCode = top_school.cds
  AND AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL

SELECT TRIM(AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2)

  AND AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT TRIM(AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3)

WITH virtual_sat AS (
    SELECT 
        s.School AS school_name,
        s.County AS county,
        sat.AvgScrRead
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
      AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        school_name,
        county,
        AvgScrRead,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM virtual_sat
)
SELECT school_name
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY county, school_name;

SELECT f.`Educational Option Type` AS education_type
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH sat AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        s.AvgScrMath,
        s.AvgScrRead,
        s.AvgScrWrite,
        (s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrWrite) AS total_score,
        sc.County
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
      AND s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
      AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    AvgScrMath,
    County
FROM sat
ORDER BY total_score ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite AS AvgWritingScore, sc.City
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School AS SchoolName, sat.AvgScrWrite AS AverageWritingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

WITH state_special AS (
    SELECT 
        s.School AS SchoolName,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS EnrollmentK12
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.DOC = 31
)
SELECT 
    SchoolName,
    EnrollmentK12
FROM state_special
WHERE EnrollmentK12 = (SELECT MAX(EnrollmentK12) FROM state_special)
ORDER BY SchoolName;

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

WITH unified_orange AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS cnt
    FROM schools
    WHERE DOC = 54
      AND County = 'Orange'
),
elementary AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS cnt
    FROM schools
    WHERE DOC = 52
)
SELECT CAST(u.cnt AS REAL) / NULLIF(e.cnt, 0) AS ratio
FROM unified_orange u, elementary e;

WITH closed_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS closed_cnt
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Closed' AND ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY County
),
max_county AS (
    SELECT County
    FROM closed_counts
    ORDER BY closed_cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.County AS CountyName,
       s.School AS SchoolName,
       s.ClosedDate AS ClosureDate
FROM schools s
JOIN max_county mc ON s.County = mc.County
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed' AND s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT GSserved, COUNT(*) AS count

ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools

  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

       s.School AS SchoolName,
       s.Latitude
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

WITH k8_magnet AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode,
           s.City,
           f.`NSLP Provision Status`
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Magnet = 1
      AND f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
      AND f.`High Grade` = '8'
),
total_multiple AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_multiple_provision
    FROM k8_magnet
    WHERE `NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
),
city_counts AS (
    SELECT s.City,
           COUNT(*) AS school_count
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
      AND f.`High Grade` = '8'
    GROUP BY s.City
)
SELECT c.City,
       c.school_count,
       t.total_multiple_provision
FROM city_counts c
CROSS JOIN total_multiple t;

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT TRIM(AdmFName1) AS firstname, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName1) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TRIM(AdmFName2) AS firstname, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName2) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TRIM(AdmFName3) AS firstname, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName3) <> ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT firstname, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY firstname
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.firstname, a.District
FROM admin_names a
JOIN name_counts n ON a.firstname = n.firstname

SELECT

SELECT

WHERE s.CharterNum = '40';

WITH filtered_schools AS (

    FROM schools

SELECT DISTINCT email

    SELECT AdmEmail2 FROM filtered_schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmEmail3 FROM filtered_schools
) AS emails

SELECT s.School AS SchoolName,
       s.AdmEmail1 AS AdministratorEmail
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

WITH avgs AS (
    SELECT

        AVG(A13) AS avg_1996

)

    END AS higher_unemployment_year,

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS district_count
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

  AND d.A11 > 8000;

WITH oldest_female AS (
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
),
min_salary_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)
),
max_salary AS (
    SELECT MAX(A11) AS max_sal FROM district
),
min_salary AS (
    SELECT MIN(A11) AS min_sal FROM district
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       (ms.max_sal - mn.min_sal) AS gap
FROM oldest_female of
JOIN min_salary_district msd ON of.district_id = msd.district_id
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = of.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
CROSS JOIN max_salary ms
CROSS JOIN min_salary mn;

WITH youngest_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
),
max_salary AS (
    SELECT MAX(d.A11) AS max_a11
    FROM youngest_clients yc
    JOIN district d ON yc.district_id = d.district_id
),
eligible_clients AS (
    SELECT yc.client_id
    FROM youngest_clients yc
    JOIN district d ON yc.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN max_salary ms ON d.A11 = ms.max_a11
)
SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN eligible_clients ec ON d.client_id = ec.client_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS owner_weekly_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'Disponent'
  AND t.k_symbol = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

WITH min_loan_amount AS (
    SELECT MIN(amount) AS min_amount
    FROM loan
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1997'
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           l.amount

)

FROM filtered

)
SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id
FROM trans t
JOIN min_1995 m ON t.date = m.min_date;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a

SELECT c.client_id

WHERE date(cr.issued) = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date

SELECT a.district_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_amount

JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

WITH highest_salary_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A11 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
accounts_in_district AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM highest_salary_district)
),
clients_in_accounts AS (
    SELECT client_id

SELECT gender

WITH max_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
account_open AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN max_loan ml ON a.account_id = ml.account_id
),
client_account AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, a.account_id, a.open_date

    JOIN account_open a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
)
SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t

WITH target_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'South Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS male_percentage

WITH first_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
client_account AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN first_loan fl ON d.account_id = fl.account_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT balance 
         FROM trans t1 
         WHERE t1.account_id = ca.account_id 
           AND t1.date <= '1993-03-22' 
         ORDER BY t1.date DESC 
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_start,
        (SELECT balance 
         FROM trans t2 
         WHERE t2.account_id = ca.account_id 
           AND t2.date <= '1998-12-27' 
         ORDER BY t2.date DESC 
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_end
    FROM client_account ca
)
SELECT ((balance_end - balance_start) / balance_start) * 100.0 AS increase_rate
FROM balances;

WITH filtered_loans AS (
    SELECT account_id, status
    FROM loan
    WHERE amount < 100000
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_running
FROM filtered_loans;

WITH debt_loans AS (

WITH total_1993 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
    FROM account

decin_1993 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS decin_cnt
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Decin'

    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),

            WHEN elem1 <= elem2 THEN elem1 || '-' || elem2

        END AS combo,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY combo

),

    SUM(CASE WHEN s.eye_colour_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg = 0 OR s.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villains
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND a.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_marvel_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name ASC;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute ha2
    WHERE ha2.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
ORDER BY height_cm DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS female_percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN al.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS good_percentage
FROM superhero sh
JOIN publisher p ON sh.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment al ON sh.alignment_id = al.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s

SELECT ha.attribute_value

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height

SELECT hero_power.hero_id

SELECT c.colour

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name AS power
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id

WITH driver_id AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE forename = 'Paul' AND surname = 'di Resta'
),
race_speeds AS (
    SELECT r.raceId,
           CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) AS speed
    FROM results r
    JOIN driver_id d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.raceId IN (853, 854)
)
SELECT ROUND(
           ((SELECT speed FROM race_speeds WHERE raceId = 853) -
            (SELECT speed FROM race_speeds WHERE raceId = 854)) /
           (SELECT speed FROM race_speeds WHERE raceId = 853) * 100,
           2) AS percent_faster;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL AND r.time <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        / COUNT(*), 
        2
    ) AS completion_rate
FROM results r
WHERE r.raceId = (
    SELECT raceId 
    FROM races 
    WHERE date = '1983-07-16'
);

SELECT COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_races, name
FROM races
WHERE year = 2005
ORDER BY name DESC;

WITH earliest AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', MIN(date)) AS yr,
        strftime('%m', MIN(date)) AS mo
    FROM races
)
SELECT r.name
FROM races r
JOIN earliest e
  ON strftime('%Y', r.date) = e.yr
 AND strftime('%m', r.date) = e.mo;

SELECT name, date
FROM races

SELECT year

SELECT DISTINCT r.name

FROM results r

JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId

FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId

SELECT AVG(lapTimes.milliseconds) AS average_lap_time
FROM lapTimes
JOIN drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId
JOIN races ON lapTimes.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND races.year = 2009

WITH hamilton_results AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.position
    FROM results r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton'
      AND ra.year >= 2010
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN position > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
    END AS percentage
FROM hamilton_results;

WITH driver_stats AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        SUM(wins) AS total_wins,
        MAX(points) AS max_points
    FROM driverStandings
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    d.nationality,
    ds.max_points
FROM driver_stats ds
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
ORDER BY ds.total_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS name
FROM drivers d
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'

WITH race_counts AS (
    SELECT r.circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_cnt
    FROM races r
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', r.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 2000
    GROUP BY r.circuitId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 4
)
SELECT c.name
FROM circuits c
JOIN race_counts rc ON c.circuitId = rc.circuitId;

FROM circuits c

WITH race_max_laps AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, MAX(res.laps) AS max_laps
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.raceId
),
overall_max AS (
    SELECT MAX(max_laps) AS overall_max_laps
    FROM race_max_laps
)
SELECT ra.name AS race_name,
       ra.year,
       c.location AS circuit_location
FROM race_max_laps rml
JOIN overall_max om ON rml.max_laps = om.overall_max_laps
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = rml.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId;

SELECT AVG(
    CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
    CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
) AS average_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL;

WITH target_race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2008
      AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS completion_rate
FROM results r
JOIN target_race tr ON r.raceId = tr.raceId;

WITH race_id AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2008
      AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champion AS (
    SELECT milliseconds AS champ_ms
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_id)
      AND position = 1
      AND time IS NOT NULL
),
last_driver AS (
    SELECT milliseconds AS last_ms
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_id)
      AND time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY position DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((last_driver.last_ms - champion.champ_ms) * 100.0) / last_driver.last_ms AS percent_faster
FROM champion, last_driver;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'British'
  AND strftime('%Y', dob) > '1980';

SELECT MAX(cr.points) AS maximum_points
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE c.nationality = 'British';

SELECT c.name, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE cr.raceId = 291
  AND cr.points = 0;

WITH japanese_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructorId
    FROM constructors
    WHERE nationality = 'Japanese'
),
zero_point_races AS (
    SELECT cr.constructorId, COUNT(*) AS zero_race_cnt
    FROM constructorResults cr
    JOIN japanese_constructors jc ON cr.constructorId = jc.constructorId
    WHERE cr.points = 0
    GROUP BY cr.constructorId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS constructor_count
FROM zero_point_races;

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM constructorStandings cs
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE cs.position = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS french_constructors_over_50_laps
FROM constructors c
JOIN results r ON c.constructorId = r.constructorId
JOIN lapTimes lt ON lt.raceId = r.raceId AND lt.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE c.nationality = 'French' AND lt.lap > 50;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        / COUNT(*), 
        2
    ) AS race_completion_percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

WITH last_race AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(raceId) AS lastRaceId
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
champion AS (
  SELECT lr.year, ds.driverId
  FROM last_race lr
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = lr.lastRaceId
  WHERE ds.position = 1
),
champion_times AS (
  SELECT c.year,
         (CAST(substr(res.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
          CAST(substr(res.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
          CAST(substr(res.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
          CAST(substr(res.time, 10, 3) AS REAL) / 1000.0) AS seconds
  FROM champion c
  JOIN results res ON res.driverId = c.driverId
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
  WHERE r.year = c.year
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
    AND c.year < 1975
)
SELECT year, AVG(seconds) AS avg_seconds
FROM champion_times
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year;

SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) > 1975
  AND r.position = 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS italian_drivers_not_finished
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
  AND r.time IS NULL;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.fastestLapTime
LIMIT 1;

WITH champion AS (
    SELECT ds.driverId
    FROM driverStandings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2009
      AND ds.position = 1
    ORDER BY r.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
fastest_lap AS (
    SELECT res.fastestLap
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN champion c ON res.driverId = c.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 2009
      AND res.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY res.fastestLapTime
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT fastestLap
FROM fastest_lap;

SELECT AVG(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_speed
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix';

SELECT ra.name, ra.year
FROM results res
JOIN races ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE res.milliseconds = (
    SELECT MIN(milliseconds)
    FROM results
    WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
LIMIT 1;

WITH drivers_in_period AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.driverId
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
),
qualified_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.driverId
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) < 1985
      AND r.laps > 50
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers_in_period) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualified_drivers) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers_in_period)
    END AS percentage;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS french_driver_count
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French'
  AND lt.milliseconds < 120000;

WITH top3_youngest AS (
    SELECT code, nationality
    FROM drivers
    WHERE code IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    GROUP_CONCAT(code) AS driver_codes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nationality IN ('Dutch', 'Netherlands') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS netherlandic_count
FROM top3_youngest;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'British'
  AND strftime('%Y', dob) = '1980';

WITH driver_laps AS (
    SELECT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        d.dob,
        MIN(l.time) AS earliest_time
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
      AND strftime('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
    GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
)
SELECT
    driverId,
    forename,
    surname,
    dob,
    earliest_time
FROM driver_laps
ORDER BY earliest_time ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT driverRef
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German'
  AND year(dob) = (
    SELECT MIN(year(dob))
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German'
  );

WITH fastest_per_race AS (
    SELECT raceId, MIN(fastestLapTime) AS min_time
    FROM results
    WHERE fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY raceId
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.code
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN fastest_per_race f ON r.raceId = f.raceId
                         AND r.fastestLapTime = f.min_time
WHERE strftime('%Y', d.dob) = '1971';

WITH spanish_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname, dob
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'Spanish'
      AND strftime('%Y', dob) < '1982'
),
driver_latest AS (
    SELECT sd.driverId,
           sd.forename,
           sd.surname,
           sd.dob,
           MAX(lt.time) AS latest_time
    FROM spanish_drivers sd
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON lt.driverId = sd.driverId
    GROUP BY sd.driverId, sd.forename, sd.surname, sd.dob
)
SELECT driverId,
       forename,
       surname,
       dob,
       latest_time
FROM driver_latest
ORDER BY latest_time DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT races.year
FROM results
JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE results.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY results.fastestLapTime
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.year
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT driverId
FROM lapTimes
WHERE lap = 1
GROUP BY driverId
ORDER BY MIN(time) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS disqualified_finishers
FROM results
WHERE raceId > 50
  AND raceId < 100
  AND time IS NOT NULL
  AND statusId = 2;

SELECT
    c.location,
    c.lat,
    c.lng,
    COUNT(r.raceId) AS times_held
FROM circuits AS c
JOIN races AS r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Austria'
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.location, c.lat, c.lng
ORDER BY times_held DESC;

SELECT r.round
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.round
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 23
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT r.year,
       r.name,
       r.date,
       r.time
FROM races r
JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE q.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY r.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS american_drivers_with_puncture
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE d.nationality = 'American'
  AND s.status = 'Puncture';

SELECT c.name, c.url
FROM constructors AS c
JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
ORDER BY SUM(cr.points) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH constructor_wins AS (
    SELECT constructorId, COUNT(*) AS total_wins
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
    GROUP BY constructorId
)
SELECT c.url
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructor_wins w ON c.constructorId = w.constructorId
ORDER BY w.total_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH french_races AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE name LIKE '%French Grand Prix%'
),
participants AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT driverId, raceId
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM french_races)
),
lap3 AS (
    SELECT p.driverId,
           p.raceId,
           lt.time,
           lt.milliseconds
    FROM participants p
    JOIN lapTimes lt
      ON lt.raceId = p.raceId
     AND lt.driverId = p.driverId
    WHERE lt.lap = 3
)
SELECT d.forename,
       d.surname,
       l.time AS slowest_time
FROM lap3 l
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE l.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM lap3)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name AS race, lt.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE lt.lap = 1
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH target_race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2006
      AND name = 'United States Grand Prix'
)
SELECT AVG(
    CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, 1, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
    CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
) AS avg_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM results
WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM target_race)
  AND rank < 11
  AND fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL;

WITH filtered_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) > 1980
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) < 1985
),
driver_avg AS (
    SELECT fd.driverId,
           fd.forename || ' ' || fd.surname AS driver_name,
           AVG(CAST(ps.duration AS REAL)) AS avg_duration
    FROM filtered_drivers fd
    JOIN pitStops ps ON ps.driverId = fd.driverId
    GROUP BY fd.driverId, driver_name
)
SELECT driver_name, avg_duration
FROM driver_avg
ORDER BY avg_duration ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver, r.time AS finish_time
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2008
  AND r.position = 1;

SELECT c.constructorRef, c.url
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
WHERE r.year = 2009
  AND r.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
  AND res.position = 1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, dob
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'Austrian'
  AND strftime('%Y', dob) BETWEEN '1981' AND '1991';

SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, url, dob
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German'
  AND strftime('%Y', dob) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985'
ORDER BY dob DESC;

WITH monaco_races AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
      AND year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT cr.constructorId,
           SUM(cr.points) AS total_points
    FROM constructorResults cr
    JOIN monaco_races mr ON cr.raceId = mr.raceId
    GROUP BY cr.constructorId
)
SELECT cp.total_points AS score,
       c.name,
       c.nationality
FROM constructor_points cp
JOIN constructors c ON cp.constructorId = c.constructorId
ORDER BY cp.total_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(r.points) AS average_score
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix';

WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT AVG(race_count) AS annual_average_races
FROM yearly_counts;

SELECT nationality
FROM drivers
GROUP BY nationality
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE res.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
  AND res.fastestLapTime = (
      SELECT MIN(fastestLapTime)
      FROM results
      WHERE fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
  )
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.location || ', ' || c.country AS full_location
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM races)
LIMIT 1;

WITH target_race AS (
    SELECT r.raceId
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
      AND r.year = 2008
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM target_race)
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH youngest AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname, nationality
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    y.forename || ' ' || y.surname AS full_name,
    y.nationality,
    r.name AS first_race_name
FROM youngest y
JOIN results res ON res.driverId = y.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
ORDER BY r.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH canada_accidents AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, COUNT(*) AS accident_count
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
      AND r.statusId = 3
    GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT MAX(accident_count) AS highest_accidents
FROM canada_accidents;

WITH oldest_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    od.forename || ' ' || od.surname AS full_name,
    COUNT(r.resultId) AS wins
FROM oldest_driver od
LEFT JOIN results r
    ON r.driverId = od.driverId
    AND r.position = 1
GROUP BY od.driverId, od.forename, od.surname;

SELECT MAX(duration) AS longest_pit_stop_duration
FROM pitStops;

SELECT time
FROM lapTimes
ORDER BY milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(p.duration) AS longest_time
FROM pitStops p
JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT ps.lap
FROM pitStops ps
JOIN races r ON ps.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2011
  AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    p.stop,
    p.duration,
    p.lap
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON p.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON p.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2011
  AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename, p.stop;

SELECT lt.time AS lap_record
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH top20_laps AS (
    SELECT lt.driverId, lt.milliseconds
    FROM lapTimes lt
    JOIN results r
        ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
       AND r.driverId = lt.driverId
    WHERE r.position <= 20
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM top20_laps t
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = t.driverId
WHERE t.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM top20_laps)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    lt.position AS driver_position
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND lt.milliseconds = (
        SELECT MIN(milliseconds)
        FROM lapTimes
        WHERE driverId = d.driverId
    )
LIMIT 1;

SELECT lt.time AS lap_record
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.name LIKE '%Austrian Grand Prix%'
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH italy_circuits AS (
    SELECT circuitId, name AS circuitName
    FROM circuits
    WHERE country = 'Italy'
),
race_laps AS (
    SELECT ic.circuitId,
           ic.circuitName,
           lt.milliseconds,
           lt.time
    FROM italy_circuits ic
    JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = ic.circuitId
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
),
min_lap AS (
    SELECT circuitId,
           circuitName,
           MIN(milliseconds) AS min_ms
    FROM race_laps
    GROUP BY circuitId, circuitName
)
SELECT ml.circuitName,
       MIN(rl.time) AS fastestLapTime
FROM min_lap ml
JOIN race_laps rl
  ON rl.circuitId = ml.circuitId
 AND rl.milliseconds = ml.min_ms
GROUP BY ml.circuitId, ml.circuitName
ORDER BY ml.circuitName;

SELECT r.name
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH austrian_circuit AS (
    SELECT circuitId
    FROM circuits
    WHERE name LIKE '%Austria%'
),
austrian_races AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE circuitId IN (SELECT circuitId FROM austrian_circuit)
),
fastest_lap AS (
    SELECT raceId, driverId
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM austrian_races)
    ORDER BY milliseconds ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT SUM(CAST(p.duration AS REAL)) AS total_pit_stop_duration
FROM fastest_lap fl
JOIN pitStops p
  ON p.raceId = fl.raceId
 AND p.driverId = fl.driverId;

WITH fastest_lap AS (
    SELECT
        r.circuitId,
        lt.time,
        lt.milliseconds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.circuitId ORDER BY lt.milliseconds) AS rn
    FROM races r
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
)
SELECT
    c.lat,
    c.lng
FROM circuits c
JOIN fastest_lap f ON c.circuitId = f.circuitId
WHERE f.rn = 1
  AND f.time = '1:29.488';

SELECT AVG(pitStops.milliseconds) AS average_pit_stop_ms
FROM pitStops
JOIN drivers ON pitStops.driverId = drivers.driverId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS average_lap_time_ms
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_name, height
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

WITH filtered_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE overall_rating >= 60
      AND overall_rating < 65
      AND defensive_work_rate = 'low'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM filtered_players;

WITH max_cross AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(crossing) AS max_crossing
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT player_api_id
FROM max_cross
ORDER BY max_crossing DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH league_goals AS (
    SELECT
        m.league_id,
        SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM `Match` m
    WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY m.league_id
)
SELECT
    l.name
FROM league_goals lg
JOIN League l ON l.id = lg.league_id
ORDER BY lg.total_goals DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH home_matches AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT home_team_api_id AS team_api_id
    FROM `Match`
    WHERE season = '2015/2016'
),
home_losses AS (
    SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS loss_count
    FROM `Match`
    WHERE season = '2015/2016'
      AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal
    GROUP BY home_team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name,
       COALESCE(l.loss_count, 0) AS loss_count
FROM home_matches hm
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = hm.team_api_id
LEFT JOIN home_losses l ON l.team_api_id = hm.team_api_id
ORDER BY loss_count ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(pa.penalties) DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH away_wins AS (
    SELECT m.away_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM `Match` m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
      AND m.season = '2009/2010'
      AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
    GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM away_wins aw
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = aw.away_team_api_id
WHERE aw.win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM away_wins)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes ta
WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ta.team_api_id
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

WITH draws AS (
    SELECT m.league_id, COUNT(*) AS draw_count
    FROM `Match` m
    WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
      AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal
    GROUP BY m.league_id
)
SELECT l.name
FROM draws d
JOIN League l ON l.id = d.league_id
ORDER BY d.draw_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH eligible_players AS (

    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,

FROM Player p

    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name

    UNION
    SELECT home_player_7 FROM `Match` WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
    UNION
    SELECT home_player_8 FROM `Match` WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')

WITH ranked_players AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        MAX(pa.overall_rating) AS best_rating
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.height > 180
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
    ORDER BY best_rating DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT player_name
FROM ranked_players
ORDER BY player_name ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND preferred_foot = 'right'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN player_api_id END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id), 
    2
  ) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT c.name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = 'Ekstraklasa';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM `Match` AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%';

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
ORDER BY ta.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS games_played
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND c.name = 'Italy'
  AND l.name = 'Serie A';

SELECT MAX(m.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Netherlands' AND l.name = 'Eredivisie';

WITH heaviest_player AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY weight DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN heaviest_player hp ON pa.player_api_id = hp.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH league_counts AS (
    SELECT m.league_id, COUNT(*) AS games
    FROM `Match` m
    WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY m.league_id
)
SELECT l.name AS league_name, lc.games
FROM league_counts lc
JOIN League l ON l.id = lc.league_id
ORDER BY lc.games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM `Match` m
JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE m.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM `Match`)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(CASE 
        WHEN p.height < 180 
             AND EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 
               FROM Player_Attributes pa 
               WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id 
                 AND pa.strength > 70
             ) 
        THEN 1 
     END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 
    2
  ) AS percentage
FROM Player p;

WITH male_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS male_inpatient,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS male_outpatient
  FROM Patient
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN male_inpatient > male_outpatient THEN 'in-patient' ELSE 'outpatient' END AS more_group,
  ROUND((male_inpatient - male_outpatient) * 100.0 / NULLIF(male_outpatient, 0), 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM male_counts;

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) > '1930' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient;

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS inpatient_percent
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = 30609;

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 163109;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND l.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

WITH female AS (
    SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F'
),
abnormal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN female f ON l.ID = f.ID
    WHERE l.TP < 6.0 OR l.TP > 8.5
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnormal) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM female), 2) AS percentage;

SELECT AVG(E.`aCL IgG`) AS average_aCL_IgG
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', `First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age
FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS women_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND p.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200;

WITH youngest_patient AS (
    SELECT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN youngest_patient yp ON e.ID = yp.ID
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS average_male_patients_per_month
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

WITH oldest_sjs AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        Birthday,
        `First Date`,
        (strftime('%Y', `First Date`) - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) AS AgeAtArrival
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS'
    ORDER BY Birthday ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = oldest_sjs.ID) AS LabDate,
    oldest_sjs.AgeAtArrival
FROM oldest_sjs;

WITH abnormal_male AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0
),
abnormal_female AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5
)
SELECT 
    CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnormal_male) AS REAL) /
    NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnormal_female), 0) AS ratio;

WITH FirstExam AS (
    SELECT ID, MIN(`Examination Date`) AS FirstExamDate
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN FirstExam fe ON p.ID = fe.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', fe.FirstExamDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_patients_with_elevated_TBIL
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_age_1999
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
);

WITH max_hgb AS (
    SELECT MAX(HGB) AS max_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
),
lab_max AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.Date, l.HGB
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN max_hgb m ON l.HGB = m.max_hgb
)
SELECT 
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Age,
    e.Diagnosis AS DoctorDiagnosis
FROM lab_max lm
JOIN Examination e 
    ON e.ID = lm.ID 
   AND e.`Examination Date` = lm.Date
JOIN Patient p 
    ON p.ID = e.ID
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ANA
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = 3605340
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN `T-CHO` < 250 THEN 'Yes' 
    ELSE 'No' 
  END AS `Is Normal`
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464 
  AND Date = '1995-09-04';

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY E.`Examination Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date = '1992-06-12' AND l.GPT = 9;

SELECT (CAST(strftime('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Age
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = 8.4
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(l.ID) AS total_tests
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1995';

SELECT e.Diagnosis AS OriginalDiagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = p.`First Date`
  AND p.ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Examination
      WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
        AND `Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  );

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-03-01'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993-09-27';

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', L.Date) = '1981-11' THEN L.`T-CHO` END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', L.Date) = '1981-12' THEN L.`T-CHO` END)) AS decrease_rate
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND Description >= '1997-01-01'
  AND Description < '1998-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND l.GPT > 30
  AND l.ALB < 4
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
  AND Admission = '+'
ORDER BY ID;

WITH avg_igm AS (
    SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) AS avg_igm
    FROM Examination
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
CROSS JOIN avg_igm a
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` > a.avg_igm * 1.2;

SELECT 
  100.0 * 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) 
     FROM Laboratory 
     WHERE `U-PRO` > 0 AND `U-PRO` < 30 AND UA <= 6.5) 
    /
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) 
     FROM Laboratory 
     WHERE `U-PRO` > 0 AND `U-PRO` < 30) 
AS percentage;

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday, P.Admission
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_women
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND Birthday BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31'
  AND ID NOT IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ID
      FROM Examination
      WHERE `ANA Pattern` = 'P'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND CAST(l.CRP AS REAL) > 2
  AND l.CRE = 1
  AND l.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(L.ALB) AS average_albumin_level
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.PLT > 400
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND Symptoms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_thrombocytopenia = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE sle_with_thrombocytopenia * 100.0 / total_thrombocytopenia
    END AS proportion_percent
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%' THEN ID END) AS total_thrombocytopenia,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%' AND Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN ID END) AS sle_with_thrombocytopenia
    FROM Examination
) AS sub;

SELECT (SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0) / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_behcet_non_admitted_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND e.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND p.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS female_patients_with_low_wbc
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5) 
    THEN 'Yes' 
    ELSE 'No' 
  END AS within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = 57266
ORDER BY l.Date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 48473
  AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1994' AND l.GOT < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.GPT >= 60;

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.GPT > 60
)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    CASE p.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'outpatient'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS treatment_type
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.ALP < 300;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Within_Normal
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP < 6.0;

SELECT
    p.ID,
    l.Date,
    (l.TP - 8.5) AS Deviation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT P.*
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory L
      WHERE L.ID = P.ID
        AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
  )
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

WITH latest_lab AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.ALB
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS MaxDate
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    ) lm ON l.ID = lm.ID AND l.Date = lm.MaxDate
)
SELECT
    p.ID,
    CASE
        WHEN ll.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Outside normal range'
    END AS AlbuminStatus
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN latest_lab ll ON p.ID = ll.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

WITH female_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
),
female_abnormal_ua AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
      AND l.UA > 6.5
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM female_abnormal_ua) 
        / 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM female_patients),
        2
    ) AS percentage;

WITH latest_lab AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.Date, l.UA
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS MaxDate
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    ) m ON l.ID = m.ID AND l.Date = m.MaxDate
)
SELECT AVG(latest_lab.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM latest_lab
JOIN Patient p ON latest_lab.ID = p.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND latest_lab.UA < 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND latest_lab.UA < 6.5);

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_patients_with_high_creatinine
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' 
  END AS result
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX AS sex
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
) sub;

SELECT
    P.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS average_age
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.`T-CHO` >= 250
  );

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS male_patient_count
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GLU >= 180
  AND l."T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT p.ID, l.GLU
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Description) = '1991'
  AND l.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.WBC <= 3.5 OR l.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY p.SEX,
         ((strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) - 
          (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))) ASC;

SELECT
    p.ID,
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RBC < 3.5
);

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Admission
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) >= 50
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0)
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.HGB < 10;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.HGB > 10
        AND l.HGB < 17
  )
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    p.ID,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) AS lower_than_normal_patients,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS higher_than_normal_patients,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS comparison_difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1984'
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) < 50
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

WITH older_patients AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX
    FROM Patient
    WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) > 55
),
abnormal_pt_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE PT >= 14
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN o.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*)
    END AS percentage_female_abnormal_pt
FROM older_patients o
JOIN abnormal_pt_patients a ON o.ID = a.ID;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p.`First Date`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) > 1992
  AND l.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID AND e.`Examination Date` = l.Date
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.APTT >= 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.APTT > 45
  AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS abnormal_fg_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5
  AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.`U-PRO` AS INTEGER) >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND CAST(l.`U-PRO` AS REAL) > 0
  AND CAST(l.`U-PRO` AS REAL) < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY l.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(p.`First Date`) >= 1990
  AND l.IGA > 80
  AND l.IGA < 500;

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.IGM <= 40 OR l.IGM >= 400
)
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP = '+' AND p.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS count_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.KCT = '+'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(p.Birthday) >= 1985
  AND l.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RF AS INTEGER) < 20
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RF AS REAL) < 20
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis = 0
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.C3 > 35
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

WITH abnormal_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HCT <= 29 OR HCT >= 52
),
patient_max_aCL AS (
    SELECT e.ID, MAX(e.`aCL IgA`) AS max_aCL
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN abnormal_patients ap ON e.ID = ap.ID
    WHERE e.`aCL IgA` IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.ID
)
SELECT ID
FROM patient_max_aCL
ORDER BY max_aCL DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND l.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.RNP IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.SM IN ('-', '+-')
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis = 0
);

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
)
ORDER BY Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(p.`First Date`) < 2000
  AND l.SSA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
)
ORDER BY p.`First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.SSB IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
WHERE e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND e.ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND l.SSB IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.DNA AS INTEGER) >= 8;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Description IS NULL
  AND l.DNA < 8;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS admitted_normal_igg_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900
  AND l.IGG < 2000
  AND p.Admission = '+';

WITH abnormal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE GOT >= 60
),
sle_abnormal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
  WHERE l.GOT >= 60
    AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
)
SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnormal), 0) * 1.0 AS percentage
FROM sle_abnormal;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_patients_normal_got
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(p.Birthday) AS YoungestBirthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GOT >= 60;

WITH NormalGPT AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS MaxGPT
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT < 60
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM NormalGPT n
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = n.ID
ORDER BY n.MaxGPT DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'

    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l

      AND l.GOT < 60
  );

SELECT MIN(p.`First Date`) AS `First Date`
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.ID = (
    SELECT l.ID

    WHERE l.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY l.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT MAX(l.`Date`) AS `Recorded Date`

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS admitted_count

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p

WHERE p.Admission = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP < 6.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.TP > 6.0
      AND l.TP < 8.5
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_patients_normal_alb_tp
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.ALB > 3.5 AND l.ALB < 5.5
  AND l.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT e.`aCL IgG`, e.`aCL IgM`, e.`aCL IgA`
FROM Examination e
WHERE e.ID = (
    SELECT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.50
    GROUP BY p.ID
    ORDER BY MAX(l.UA) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT MAX(e.ANA) AS highest_anti_nucleus_antibody

WHERE e.ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID

    WHERE l.CRE < 1.5
);

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e

      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l

  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0

SELECT e.ANA

WHERE e.ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory

    ORDER BY `T-BIL` DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory l
INNER JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID

  AND e.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
WHERE e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = e.ID
        AND l.`T-CHO` < 250
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l

SELECT p.Diagnosis

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count

SELECT MIN(p.Birthday) AS Birthday
FROM Patient p

WHERE l.GLU > 180;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.GLU < 180
  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS sle_normal_wbc_patients
FROM Patient p

JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count

WHERE p.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL

    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID

SELECT L.ID, L.PLT

SELECT AVG(L.PT) AS AverageProthrombinTime

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count

WITH elijah AS (

),
filtered_expenses AS (
    SELECT e.cost, b.link_to_event
    FROM expense e
    JOIN elijah m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%m', e.expense_date) AS INTEGER) IN (9, 10)
),
event_totals AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
    FROM filtered_expenses
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total_cost
FROM event_totals;

)

    MIN(z.state) AS country

WITH member_event_expenses AS (
    SELECT

        e.cost
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
),
member_event_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        member_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) AS event_cnt,
        SUM(cost) AS total_cost
    FROM member_event_expenses
    GROUP BY member_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) > 1
)
SELECT 
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,

    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
cte_join AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           c.CustomerID,
           COALESCE(cc.total_cons, 0) AS total_cons
    FROM cte_cust c
    LEFT JOIN cte_cons cc ON c.CustomerID = cc.CustomerID
),
cte_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM cte_join
    GROUP BY Segment
),
cte_lowest AS (
    SELECT j.Segment, j.total_cons
    FROM cte_join j
    JOIN cte_min m
      ON j.Segment = m.Segment
     AND j.total_cons = m.min_cons
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_cons) / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM cte_lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)

           substr(ym.Date,1,4) AS Year,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM eur_customers ec
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON ec.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE substr(ym.Date,1,4) IN ('2012','2013')
    GROUP BY ec.Segment, substr(ym.Date,1,4)
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MAX(CASE WHEN Year='2012' THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Cons2012,
           MAX(CASE WHEN Year='2013' THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Cons2013
    FROM cons_year
    GROUP BY Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           ((Cons2013 - Cons2012) / Cons2013) * 100.0 AS PctIncrease
    FROM pivot
    WHERE Cons2013 IS NOT NULL AND Cons2012 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease, 'biggest' AS Type
FROM pct
ORDER BY PctIncrease DESC
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT Segment, PctIncrease, 'lowest' AS Type
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PctIncrease
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY PctIncrease ASC
    LIMIT 1
);
